## Submission checklist

- [ ] I added or updated exactly one MCP server entry under `servers/<category>/<slug>/`.
- [ ] Its category matches the folder and the taxonomy.
- [ ] Its project URL and metadata can be checked publicly.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs` and `node scripts/validate-taxonomy.mjs`.
- [ ] I have **not** manually edited `README.md` or `categories/*.md` (generated by maintainers).
- [ ] I disclosed relevant risky tool capabilities and any relationship to the submitted service.
